1.title: Trump paused attacks on Iran to make space for talks, US ambassador says
1.summary: Neither the US nor Iran have launched attacks in the last two nights, after almost two weeks of tit-for-tat strikes risked derailing talks to permanently end the war.

2.title: Man Convicted of Shoving Flaming Car Into Gully, Igniting Giant Wildfire
2.summary: The 2024 fire in Northern California was one of the state’s largest wildfires ever. The man faces a prison sentence of 25 years to life.

3.title: Seattle Police Search for 2 Men Who Parachuted From the Space Needle
3.summary: The men face criminal trespassing charges after they climbed over the glass wall of the observation deck of the city landmark and jumped from the ledge Friday evening.

4.title: Extreme Heat and Strong Winds Fuel New Wildfires in France and Spain
4.summary: Firefighters are tackling fresh blazes while others have been contained, and hundreds of thousands of people have been forced to flee. A new heat wave forecast to hit Europe could make conditions worse.

5.title: Berlin Pride Event Attacker Killed in Police Shootout, Officials Say
5.summary: The confrontation with the suspect in what has been described as a likely act of Islamist terrorism occurred as a large-scale manhunt was underway, the authorities said.

6.title: PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
6.summary: The Ukrainian president will be Andy Burnham's first international visitor since taking office.
